translations.en: Yay! I swear, you look positively divine right now!
Now, about the cellar's location.
Apparently, there's a sign nearby saying Morellen.
translations.note: Morellen is editorial Dutch place-name orthography; source identifies a nearby sign.

translations.en: It belonged to a distillery called Pezik on Morellen Street.
translations.note: Pezik follows the source spelling rather than silently correcting it to Dutch Perzik.

translations.en: They say it was quite a large distillery.
That's all I've got to go on, though.
All right! Let's get going!
Whaaat?! Why, why, why?!
It's legendary liquor! Legendary! Do you understand?
If it's fine liquor from three hundred years ago, it'll be worth a fortune!
This is treasure hunting by another name!
Change your mind and come with me!
No? Really, absolutely no? You won't?
Tch. You're no fun.
Well, let me know if you change your mind.
Hey, hey, hey! Listen, listen, listen!
There's this amazing rumor! It's legendary!
There's an ancient liquor cellar somewhere in @6rDiemen@0r.
There might still be fine liquor from hundreds of years ago inside.
That's the rumor!
If it's been stored properly, it's bound to be good!
So will you help me look for it?
I'll pay you well. Please? Please? Please?
Please! I'm begging you! Come to the labyrinth with me!
You pick up the reward left on the counter.
You obtained three bottles of @3rRestorative@0r.
A grimy box sits on the counter.
Something appears to be written on it.
"Please deposit ten bottles of @3rHealing Salve Concentrate@0r.
You will be suitably rewarded."
Nothing else is written there.
Put the @3rHealing Salve Concentrate@0r in the box?
When you put the @3rHealing Salve Concentrate@0r in the box,
you hear a sound, and the bottom of the box opens.
There are items inside. This must be your reward.
You decide to leave it alone.
Something is written on the bottom.
"We look forward to your next visit."
You do not have enough @3rHealing Salve Concentrate@0r.
You decide to ignore the box.
Welcome back. Did everything go well?
You explain that you found an exit leading to @2rRukin@0r,
reporting your discovery to @7rBeatrix@0r.
So there was another town beyond the seal.
It's good to have more bases for our explorations.
We can't move our base to @2rRukin@0r just yet,
but I'll start preparing so we can move whenever we need to.
This is a wonderful discovery, and a major step forward.
I'll begin researching @2rRukin@0r.
In any case, well done.
Here's your reward. Please take it.
From @7rBeatrix@0r, you received a reward of @3r5,000 G@0r.
Is the survey going well?
I'd like you to make progress without taking too long.
Oh? Have you decided to do it?
Making a map is a simple but important job.
Where does @6rStrage Labyrinth@0r lead?
That's what I need you to find out.
Will you do it?
It might be an easy job for you,
but it's an unfamiliar labyrinth. Don't let your guard down.
As far as I know, no adventurer
has ever entered it. Naturally, there are no maps.
Of course, adventurers from @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r time
may have explored it.
Well, take care.
You have accepted a request to find where @6rStrage Labyrinth@0r leads
and draw a map of the route.
I see. You won't accept...
There's no one else I can ask,
so please come and see me if you change your mind.
I have a job I'd like you to do.
There's a rumor that @6rStrage Labyrinth@0r
has a passage leading out somewhere.
I'd like you to draw a map so we can verify it.
You don't need to map the whole labyrinth.
I just need a map that tells us
where that passage leads.
May I ask you to do it?
Welcome back. Where have you been?

context: Fiore describes the distillery; a self-service box exchanges supplies; Beatrix requests a survey of Strage.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
